summary.name: Zen Browser
summary.one_liner: Zen is a privacy-focused, feature-rich web browser with a focus on design and productivity.
use_cases: comparing two web pages side by side
quickly switching between frequently used tabs
summary.what_it_does: Zen is a web browser marketed as beautifully designed, privacy-focused, and packed with features. It offers Workspaces to group tabs by project and switch between them. Compact Mode hides the tab bar when it is not needed and shows it when required, giving more screen space. Glance lets users quickly switch between their most-used tabs without scrolling through history. Split View displays two tabs side by side for comparison.
notable: Workspaces for separating tabs by project
Compact Mode hides the tab bar when not needed
Split View shows two tabs side by side
Listed as open source (GitHub repository linked) and freeware in awesome-mac
caveats: The page does not state platforms beyond the awesome-mac listing context; macOS is inferred from the awesome-mac listing
Sponsor and donation funding is mentioned; no paid tiers are described
